headline.en: Configure the matchday you would consider — without pretending it is on sale

principle.en: A player-led spike is not enough. Product, fixture, origin, party size and willingness to pay must align before inventory or travel is negotiated.
principle.es: Un pico vinculado a una jugadora no basta. Producto, partido, origen, grupo y disposición a pagar deben coincidir antes de negociar inventario o viaje.

text.en: This page validates demand; it does not sell, reserve inventory or accept payment.
